in_marathi.name: Radhakrishna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in the form of Krishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radhakrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The combination of the names Radha (meaning 'pleasing to the senses') and Krishna (meaning 'all-attractive') represents the ultimate form of God who is the source of all pleasure and attractiveness.

in_bengali.name: Radhakrishna
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God in the form of Krishna
in_bengali.long_meaning: Radhakrishna একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The combination of the names Radha (meaning 'pleasing to the senses') and Krishna (meaning 'all-attractive') represents the ultimate form of God who is the source of all pleasure and attractiveness.
